page.title: Leap of Faith Jump Engine Mod - Custom Texts
page.descr: Custom research, equipment mod and message texts added by the Leap of Faith Jump Engine Mod
page.t: Boso Ta's analysis of the jump data collected from ships crossing the anomaly between Avarice and Leap of Faith reveals a consistent pattern - enough to design an engine modification that lets any ship make the crossing permanently.
An engine modification developed from Boso Ta's anomaly jump research. Ships fitted with it can permanently traverse the anomaly between Avarice and Leap of Faith.

The data from your jump through the Avarice V anomaly to Leap of Faith is quite revealing. I believe there's a pattern here. If I could get a few more data points, I'm sure it would lead to an exciting research opportunity.
I've gathered enough jump data now to chart a reliable pattern! I can start real research on an engine modification that should let any ship make the crossing permanently.
